mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently 31 degrees with clear skies outside Verona City Hall, feeling like 25 degrees under a waning crescent moon.
There are no new city news articles or email announcements to report at this time.

Looking at events, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market today on the Capitol Square, or enjoy live music today at Baileys Run Vineyard and Paddy Macs. Looking ahead to next week, trivia nights return to Hop Haus brewing and Lake Lou-ee on Tuesday.
The Verona Police Department has not released a weekly recap today, reflecting a quiet period across the city.
Culvers opens today at 10:00 AM, and today's featured flavor of the day is Andes Mint Avalanche.
